rules.runtimeLiveMeans: asset exists under Assets/Resources and Foundation content defines the id
rules.generatedOnlyMeans: asset exists under Assets/Generated and needs promotion before Resources lookup works
rules.biomeSketchOnlyMeans: asset exists only in the review/sketch tool and needs art-lane promotion

placement._: ore frequency rises with height (owner rule)

biomeSuite._: Authoring contract for biome-scale generation. Runtime authority remains footprint cell + integer height; this file only describes semantic rule intent.

globalPlacement.transitionBandPolicy: use sparse accents and avoid blockers
globalPlacement.heightEdgePolicy: props may decorate edges only when their feature explicitly opts in
globalPlacement.occupancyPolicy: reserve every prop footprint before placing the next prop

coast.role: shoreline band between ocean and land
coast.waterEdgePolicy: sand apron first, sparse shore props second, no buildings on wet band

snow.role: cold sparse biome with frozen aprons
snow.transitionPolicy: grass-through-snow tiles only in authored thaw bands

dungeons.rule: dungeon rooms use dungeon floor pools; building interiors use interior/planks; never use overworld grass/snow/coast surfaces inside void instances

settlements._: Settlement placement contract. Farther from spawn means lower frequency, larger footprint, higher service tier, and richer stock.

globalRules.requiredFlatness: max height delta 0 inside plaza, max delta 1 at settlement edge
globalRules.roadPolicy: one main road spine, side paths to doors, at least two exits to wilderness

bands.rule: spawn is a safe clearing, not a town

propInteractions._: Stable mapping from generated prop ids to gameplay interaction categories. Art can be review-only; runtime must gate on promotion status before spawning.

interactionTypes.resource_node: harvestable node with tool affinity and respawn rules
interactionTypes.vendor_or_job: opens town service, shop, guild, or tavern job board
interactionTypes.ambient: presentation-only unless promoted to a specific gameplay rule
interactionTypes.floor_overlay: rendered over a floor tile, non-authoritative for movement

ambient.rule: spawn at night in forest/meadow clearings
rare night spawn near ruins, dungeons, or magic biomes
